vid_urls.title: U.S. Spacewalk 100
vid_urls.description:
Join us for a spacewalk milestone!

NASA astronaut Anil Menon and CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk are participating in the 100th spacewalk conducted from the International Space Station's Quest airlock without the space shuttle present. This will be the 285th spacewalk conducted to build, maintain, and upgrade the orbiting laboratory.

Menon and Kutryk are expected to begin their spacewalk at about 8:00 a.m. EDT (1200 UTC); they'll be installing a new International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Array (IROSA), which will boost the station's power.

Learn more about today's spacewalk: https://go.nasa.gov/4yRBm97
Get daily updates from the space station: https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/

image.name: US EVA Astronaut outside the ISS

description: NASA astronaut Anil Menon and CSA astronaut Joshua Kutryk will exit the station’s Quest airlock to install and deploy an International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Array (IROSA) on the 2A electrical power channel. The solar array will be the seventh IROSA and will provide additional power to support critical station operations, including its safe and controlled deorbit.
